import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, sharex=True, sharey=True)
x = np.arange(0.0, 2*np.pi, 0.01)
y = np.sin(x)
for ax in axes.flatten():
    ax.clear()
    ax.plot(x, y)
fig.canvas.draw()

def label1on(axis):
    return sorted({t.label1.get_visible() for t in axis.get_major_ticks()})

ok = True
for i, ax in enumerate(axes.flatten()):
    x1 = label1on(ax.xaxis)
    y1 = label1on(ax.yaxis)
    # shared axes: only bottom row shows x labels, only left col shows y labels
    expect_x = i >= 2
    expect_y = i in (0, 2)
    good = (all(x1) == expect_x) and (all(y1) == expect_y)
    ok &= good
    print(f"ax{i}: x label1On={x1} (expect all {expect_x}), y label1On={y1} (expect all {expect_y}) -> {'OK' if good else 'BUG'}")
print("RESULT:", "FIXED/GOOD" if ok else "BUG PRESENT")
EOF
